Name: Leafy Green Rain Tree Retexture
Author: Lybell4rt
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[b]Are you stressed out about trees that get ugly in fall[/b]? Then install this mode! The leaves on the Green Rain Tree become more abundant.

This mod changes the texture of green rain trees (aka. moss trees) that change with a 5% probability in fall.
Overall, I designed it similar to the original tree, and we changed the design slightly from the original tree to allow for minimal distinction.

- Mutated oak tree: It has leaves that hang down. In the fall, acorns grow on the tree.
- Mutated maple tree: It becomes a ginkgo tree.

Also, when moss grows on a green rain tree, it has a texture that grows cute mushrooms.

[size=4][b]Requirement[/b][/size]
- Requires Smapi 4.0.7 and over.
- Requires Content Patcher 2.2.0 and over.

Manifest.Name: (CP) Leafy Green Rain Tree Retexture
Manifest.Description: Makes green rain trees that become leafless in fall into variations similar to the original trees.
